description: A support-agent session with 4 tickets (45 messages). The help-center search returns the same article for every ticket (duplicates), finished tickets are good archive candidates, and issue_refund and send_reply are side-effect tools that must be kept.

function.name: lookup_customer
function.description: Look up a customer by email.

function.name: issue_refund
function.description: Refund an order. Has side effects.

function.name: send_reply
function.description: Send a reply to the ticket. Has side effects.

messages.content: You are a support agent for Example Store. Resolve each ticket: look up the customer and order, check the help center, issue refunds only when policy allows, and always send a reply. Refund policy: within 30 days, unused items only.
New ticket T-1001 from alex@example.com: The kettle arrived with a cracked lid. Order O-5001.
